# tenure agent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureAgent`](gmeow-tenureAgent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureAgent>

- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent whose intentional mode an intention-tenure records. Functional: one tenure, one agent.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureAgent`](gmeow-tenureAgent.md) from [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind an [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) to the single agent whose holding-over-time it records.

### Avoid when

- Avoid on a bare mode (the bearer there is [`gmeow:intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md)) and avoid more than one agent per tenure; it is functional — one tenure, one agent.

### How to use

- Point the tenure at exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), matching the [`gmeow:intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md) of the mode named by [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](gmeow-tenureIntention.md).
